title: Hello, I finally know what Mallworld is!🙂🙏🏾
content: Hello, I finally know what Mallworld is! Mallworld is not a specific place to begin with; it is not a localized place nor one that exists in the sense that it is pure consciousness, In fact there are lobbies for AI in the astral, these zones are formed on the plane of consciousness and bring together the same categories of souls, The universe, if I can say so, where mallWord and all these inter-incarnation lobby areas are located, is a special universe of pure consciousness where the expansion is infinite and where you can manipulate the energy to make your own projections according to your level of energetic vibration, mallworld can represent a shopping center, a large hotel, an idyllic plain with two suns, an immense vessel the size of the earth levitating in space, malllworld and in fact a shapeshifting program which receives the consciousnesses which are similar on the vibrational level, I had this deduction because I myself dreamed of a very large hotel which had gigantic dimensions, and with wavy and circular parts to mark the floors, there were countless rooms, I remember this dream because I was in a state of absolute serenity, I was in my place recognized for my true value without even opening my mouth, I remember a moment that we were together at least 6 people but all different because each had chosen the shape they preferred like animals or humanoid species that I didn't know, so there were improbable shapes coming from different simulations but all are soul mates, we had already shared things in other simulations together, I chose - even I chose to remain in humanoid and "human" form. These lobbies are impressive in their energetic accuracy, you are in the right place and the risks of suffering are very very limited, When I woke up I immediately wanted to go back and yet I suffer from nothing here and I lack nothing in my current life, I even find this simulation quite cool to be frank (so tempted that one take it for what it is, an evolving experience) but I felt that this place was really the ideal for my consciousness, not for the realization of my soul moreover but more in the love and authenticity that there was to exchange with my soul mates, we formed a truly united group and in total osmosis, the humor was very present there too, a bit like Very Bad Trip but without all these drug stories I don't know if I make me understand mzis there was really a really badass aspect and above all there was always this feeling that my soul mates could know directly by reading my aura or my consciousness I don't know but they could understand the subtle character of my soul, its on the playful side, teasing etc, but I would go even further, they could even potentially know my level of humor or expertise in certain areas, I did not open my mouth as such but the communication was established as if in a certain way thanks to the personality of my essence and thanks to the manipulation of the form of my energy, I managed to make myself understood, or to explain differently others could perceive in real time every subtle detail of my energy and have the answer he wanted by analyzing the most subtle aspects and configurations of my soul and the feedback from my past lives, all with more or less humor and seriousness depending on whether I want it or not, it was truly a perpetual soul-to-soul dialogue if I may say so! in any case I was sincerely loved and I was really in my place and recognized as living up to what I really am deep down, you can't lie there :)
